property-disallowed-list.message: Use the logical property instead (margin-inline-start, padding-inline-end, inset-inline-start, border-start-start-radius, …). Physical left/right properties break RTL.

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: This value encodes left/right asymmetry and will not mirror in RTL. Use the logical form: padding-inline / margin-inline / inset-inline, the border-*-*-radius longhands, float: inline-start, or text-align: start|end.

overrides._comment: Scoped exception: custom-property-pattern and selector-class-pattern encode OUR --t-* / .t-* naming convention. src/styles/bootstrap/** is the Bootstrap bridge — the layer that assigns --t-* tokens onto Bootstrap's own --bs-* custom properties and restyles Bootstrap's own classes (.btn, .navbar-brand, …). Those are vendor names we consume, not names we author, so the project pattern does not — and should not — apply to them. Every other stylesheet keeps both patterns at full strength.
